name: Auris
summary: Flutter UI kit and Material 3 theme with an amber-on-near-black sci-fi HUD look plus custom widgets.
description: A drop-in ThemeData plus a library of custom HUD widgets in a chamfered, glowing sci-fi style. AurisTheme re-skins standard Material 3 widgets; auris_widgets adds patterns Material cannot express — panels, badges, stat tiles, segmented meters, chamfered switches, terminals, scan brackets and hex ornaments. Ships light and dark variants with accent/bevel/glow overrides and bundled fonts; purely presentational with zero runtime dependencies.
contains: Flutter UI kit: AurisTheme ThemeData plus 14 custom HUD widgets
custom widgets: panel, badge, stat card, segmented meter, switch, radio, select, terminal, scan bracket
light and dark variants with accent, bevel and glow overrides
bundled fonts: Rajdhani, Exo 2, Share Tech Mono
